newsitem.title: GREECE: Delta says 96 pretax profit up 14pct.
newsitem.headline: Delta says 96 pretax profit up 14pct.

text.p: Greece's Delta Dairy 1996 pretax profit rose 14 percent to 3.5 billion drachmas from 3.069 billion in 1995 but turnover fell 3.6 percent to 71.0 from 73.7 billion, it told institutional investors on Wednesday.
Delta Dairy enjoys big market shares, 41 percent in fresh milk, 65 percent in fruit juices, 26 percent in the yogurt market and 49 percent in ice cream, it said.
It exports to many Balkan and European countries.
Delta aims to improve its sales and profit by the year 2000.
It hopes to be able to serve 300 million consumers by that time, it said.
To raise profits domestically and internationally, the company plans to launch new products with a higher profit margin in Greece while trying to control costs abroad, it said.
